profile.headline: Junior Software Developer
profile.summary: Over ten years of experience in Quality Assurance testing desktop and portable video games, mobile applications, websites, digital media streaming apps and augmented reality software.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
● Primary QA expert for Symbiotic: Invasion on Steam.
● Participated in GameJamPlus 24/25 as a quality analyst and repository manager for 3DRBH: Cosmic Horrors and JellyBeats.

positions.title: Software QA Tester
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Assigned company: Disney Parks, Experiences and Products

● Performed manual testing of The Disney Store eCommerce app for Android and iOS mobile devices.
● Designed, implemented and maintained test suites and cases using both TestRail and Xray Test Management for Jira.
● Manually setup push notifications in Adobe Campaign to validate deep linking into the app.
● Instructed testers on how to use testing tools such as Charles Proxy and BrowserStack App Live.
positions.insights: Skills: Critical Thinking · Regression Testing · Mobile Applications · Black Box Testing · Mobile Games · Documentation · Software Documentation · Software Quality Assurance · JIRA

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Assigned company: Disney Parks, Experiences and Consumer Products.

● Mastered Star Wars: Jedi Challenges and MARVEL Dimension of Heroes for the Lenovo Mirage AR headset.
● Quickly learned and tested proprietary business transaction and asset management software.
● Worked closely with developers and product management to create reasonable testing schedules and comprehensive test coverage.
● Assisted in testing the shopDisney eCommerce app for Windows desktop, Android and iOS mobile devices.
positions.insights: Skills: Video Games · Critical Thinking · Regression Testing · Mobile Applications · Black Box Testing · Mobile Games · Documentation · Software Documentation · Software Quality Assurance

positions.title: Live Ops QA Tester
positions.description:
Assigned company: Scopely Inc.

● Manually setup and tested in-app purchases and live service updates within The Walking Dead: Road to Survival for Android and iOS mobile devices.
● Coordinated with developers in the planning and execution of new testing strategies around in-game events.
● Wrote improved documentation for current design tools used by both testers and developers.
positions.insights: Skills: Video Games · Critical Thinking · Regression Testing · Mobile Applications · Black Box Testing · Mobile Games · Documentation · Software Documentation · Software Quality Assurance

positions.title: Mobile QA Tester
positions.description:
Assigned company: Disney Consumer Products and Information Media.

● Lead writing and implementation of up-to-date testing procedure for each content release of Club Penguin for Windows desktop computers, Android and iOS mobile devices.
● Used regex tools to quickly confirm correct setup of new game content in the back-end before needing to perform any manual testing.
●  Other projects tested includes:
    Club Penguin Island (Android and iOS mobile devices)
    Frozen Free Fall (Windows PC and Amazon mobile devices)
    Maleficent Free Fall (Windows PC and Amazon mobile devices)
    Disney Emoji Blitz (Windows PC, Windows mobile and Amazon mobile devices)
    Disney Dream Treats (Android and iOS mobile devices)
    Disney Crossy Road (Windows PC and mobile devices)
    Zootopia: Crime Files (Facebook Gameroom service)
positions.insights: Skills: Video Games · Critical Thinking · Regression Testing · Mobile Applications · Black Box Testing · Mobile Games · Documentation · Software Documentation · Software Quality Assurance

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description:
Assigned company: Disney Interactive Studios.

● Performed black box and regression testing for the following software:
    Disney's Planes (video game) (Nintendo WII, Wii U and DS gaming systems)
    Disney Epic Mickey 2 (Windows PC)
    Disney Infinity (Xbox 360, PlayStation 3 gaming systems)
    Where's My Water? 2 (Android and iOS mobile devices)
    Where's My Water Featuring XYY (Android and iOS mobile devices)
    Seven Dwarves: The Queen's Return (Windows 8 tablet device)
    Disney XD Grand Prix (iOS mobile devices)
    Disney Super Speedway (mobile devices)
    Disney Memories HD (Android mobile devices)

● Tested the WATCH Disney (Channel; XD; Junior) and WATCH ABC applications for Android, iOS and Windows mobile devices, as well as various video streaming devices (eg. Google Chromecast, Android TV, Kindle Fire TV, etc.)

projects.title: Sonic for GMS
projects.description:
A GameMaker project template for designing 2D video games based on the Sonic the Hedgehog series. 

Used to develop the fan game Sonic the Hedgehog: Time Twisted (https://github.com/overbound/SonicTimeTwisted)

* Supports Windows PC and Android operating systems with fully implemented touch screen controls
* Close-to-accurate physics system that adapts to high movement speed and non-standard gravity direction
